podcast.title: Addiction and Suicide Education Mission
podcast.body: Following her father Chris Cornell's death in 2017, Toni embarked on a public mission to educate people about addiction and suicide. "After Chris died in 2017, Tony went on a mission to educate the public against things like addiction and suicide."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Involvement with Chris's Foundation
podcast.body: Toni is actively involved with Chris Cornell's foundation, which is dedicated to helping homeless, poor, and neglected children. "She's also part of Chris's foundation that works to help homeless, poor and neglected children."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Preserving Father's Memory
podcast.body: Along with her older sister Lillian, Toni keeps her father's memory alive by performing his songs in both online and live settings. "Both of them have been keeping their fathers' memory alive by performing a songs both online and live."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
